comparison.objective: Hold a cord taut and sever it safely with a knife; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual tensioning and controlled cutting with hand/blade separation versus hex-bit insertion, bounded screw torque, collar rotation and testing.
comparison.success_condition: Cord must be cut while held, away from hand and anchor, with knife safely set down; candidate requires two force- and travel-compliant impact cycles.
comparison.reason: Both involve force control and safe sequencing, but cutting a tensioned cord is a materially different ability.
